ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 ratio of high-intensity (white/light gray) to low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white field across both lobes. Dark pigmentation concentrated at the peripheral margins, specifically the leading edges and distal tips. A distinct vertical dark pixel cluster is centered below the median notch extending towards the peduncle.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an estimated interior angle of 50-60 degrees; depth is roughly 1/10th of the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 2-8 pixels; most pronounced and jagged at the distal 25% of both the left and right lobe trailing boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curvature from the median notch to the midpoint of each lobe, transitioning to a slight upward taper at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Scattered small dark pixel clusters (2-5 pixel diameter) localized primarily on the lower medial quadrant of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, diagonal dark linear disruptions visible on the upper mid-section of the right lobe and lower section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular jaggedness and potential tissue loss on the far outer tips of both lobes, resulting in a non-uniform terminal edge.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, prominent dark vertical smudge or streak descending directly from the center of the median notch into the white field.
